task_description: Build a complete NAS100 signal-only trading bot that detects statistically-proven edges from research data, computes Kelly-optimal sizing suggestions, scores confluence, and alerts the user via Telegram. The bot NEVER auto-executes trades - it is signal-only. The user decides all trade execution and risk sizing.

verification.summary: pip install succeeds, 122 tests pass in 0.09s, --dry-run mode fetches real market data and evaluates all edges correctly. Tests cover edge detection (triggered/not-triggered cases), Kelly math correctness, signal generation logic, and timing utilities. All tests exercise real logic and would fail if implementations were reverted. Semantic review: APPROVED.
